about: Corrections to the manual-extracted TP syntax from real controllers: every line was loaded as a one-line .LS by scripts/tp-option-probe.mjs on two V9.40 ROBOGUIDE controllers (HandlingTool R-2000iC/210L with iRCalibration, Palletizing, Line Tracking, iRPickTool, iRVision; SpotTool+ R-2000iC/210L with Servo Gun, Force Control, Path Switching) on 2026-10-03. Applied by scripts/import-tp-syntax.mjs after the merge. 'probe' records what the controller did.

instruction:DETECT POINT.reason: 'Detect Point[1] World[-X]' rejected (ASBN-031) on HandlingTool V9.40; the controller spells it Detect_Point - merged into instruction:DETECT_POINT

instruction:DETECT_POINT.probe: accepted as written: Detect_Point[1] UTool[-Z] (SpotTool+), Detect_Point[1] World[-X] (HandlingTool)

instruction:UTOOL START.reason: 'UTool Start[1]' rejected (ASBN-092); the controller takes UTool_Start[n] / UTool_End[..] - instruction:UTOOL_START, instruction:UTOOL_END

notes: The bracket holds the calibration mode the program was created with, e.g. UTool_End[New_XYZWPR]; UTool_End[Cal-Plate] was rejected on V9.40 (ASBN-031).

Spelled with an underscore in the program; 'UFrame Start[1]' is the pendant's display and is rejected by the loader. The matching end instruction was not confirmed (UFrame_End[Cal-Plate] was rejected).
instruction:UFRAME START.probe: accepted: UFrame_Start[1]; rejected: UFrame Start[1], UFrame_End[Cal-Plate]

notes: Spelled with an underscore in the program; 'Calib Start[1]' is rejected by the loader.
instruction:CALIB START.probe: accepted as written: Calib_Start[1], Calib_End[Calibration], Calib_End[Recovery]

notes: Spelled with an underscore in the program; 'Detect Circle[1]...' is rejected (ASBN-031).
Spelled with an underscore in the program; 'Detect Joint[1] ...' is rejected (ASBN-031).
Spelled with an underscore; 'Update Frame' and 'Update_TCP' are rejected on V9.40 - the tool version is Update_Tool.
instruction:UPDATE FRAME.probe: accepted: Update_Frame; rejected: Update Frame, Update_TCP

instruction:END COND ON.reason: 'END COND ON' (the pendant menu's short name) rejected (ASBN-092); programs use END CONDITION ON/OFF - instruction:END CONDITION ON

notes: 'END COND' on the pendant's instruction menu is an abbreviation; the program line is END CONDITION ON/OFF (END COND ON is rejected).
instruction:END CONDITION ON.probe: accepted: END CONDITION OFF; rejected: END COND ON

instruction:TRQ ERROR ON.reason: 'TRQ ERROR OFF' rejected (ASBN-098); programs use TORQUE ERROR ON/OFF

instruction:GET DIAG DATA.reason: 'GET DIAG DATA' rejected (ASBN-092); programs use GET DIAGNOSIS DATA

motion-option:SOFT FLOAT[N] (MOTION OPTI.reason: 'L P[1] 100mm/sec FINE Soft Float[1]' rejected (ASBN-092); the option is SOFTFLOAT[n] - motion-option SOFTFLOAT[n] (accepted)

notes: A pallet register is compared with a [row,column,layer] element, not with R[]: 'IF PL[1]=R[2],JMP LBL[1]' is rejected on V9.40.
instruction:IF PL.probe: accepted: IF PL[1]=[1,1,1],JMP LBL[1], IF PL[1]<>[1,1,2],JMP LBL[1], PL[1]=[1,1,1]; rejected: IF PL[1]=R[2],JMP LBL[1]

notes: A mixed-logic IF needs the comma before its action: IF (DI[1]),JMP LBL[1] - without it the line is rejected (ASBN-092).
function:MIXED LOGIC EXPRESSION ( ... ).probe: accepted: WAIT (DI[1]); rejected: IF (DI[1]) JMP LBL[1]

notes: Math functions are only legal inside a mixed-logic expression in parentheses: R[1]=(ABS[R[2]]); R[1]=ABS[R[2]] is rejected.
function:IF.probe: accepted: R[1]=(ABS[R[1]]) and every function in parentheses; rejected without the parentheses

notes: ErrorLBL[n] is required: FORCE CTRL[1] alone is rejected. The controller stores the label on a continuation line (FORCE CTRL[1:] then : ErrorLBL[0]).
instruction:FORCE CTRL.probe: accepted: FORCE CTRL[1] ErrorLBL[0] -> 'FORCE CTRL[1:]' + ': ErrorLBL[0]'; rejected: FORCE CTRL[1]

notes: Every PS form shown in the manual was rejected (ASBN-092) on a V9.40 SpotTool+ controller with Path Switching (J693) installed; the program-line spelling is unconfirmed.
instruction:PS.probe: rejected: PS -100mm +0.2sec,DO[1]=(ON) and 4 variants; the calling DB line was accepted

notes: On a V9.40 SpotTool+ servo-gun controller the loader keeps only SPOT[S=n] (plus ANTIC=): SPOT[BU=*,P=M,S=2,BU=*] is stored as SPOT[S=2], on a continuation line after the motion. The BU/EP/P fields belong to other gun types.
instruction:SPOT.probe: accepted: L P[1] 500mm/sec FINE SPOT[BU=*,P=M,S=2,BU=*] -> L P[1] 500mm/sec FINE + :SPOT[S=2]

notes: On a V9.40 SpotTool+ servo-gun controller SPOT[BU=C,S=1,BU=O,ANTIC(B=300,G=150)] is stored as SPOT[S=1,ANTIC=150] - the gun value only.
On a V9.40 SpotTool+ servo-gun controller the stored forms are SPOT[S=n,ANTIC=m] and BACKUP[B=OPEN|CLOSE,ANTIC=m], each on a continuation line after the motion.
The controller writes it in capitals on a continuation line: L P[1] 2000mm/sec FINE then : PRESS_MOTN[SD=1,P=1,t=2.0].

instruction:RESET WATER SAVER.probe: accepted: J P[1] 50% FINE RESET WATER SAVER -> + :RESET WATER SAVER

notes: On a V9.40 SpotTool+ servo-gun controller TIPDRESS[SD=1,P=1,t=1,TD=1,ED=1] is stored as TIPDRESS[TD=1].

motion-option:BACKUP[B=...,ANTIC=M].probe: accepted as written: J P[4] 100% FINE BACKUP[B=CLOSE,ANTIC=20] (on a continuation line)

notes: BACKUP=OPEN / BACKUP=CLOSE are rejected (ASBN-021 Expecting a [) on a V9.40 SpotTool+ controller; write BACKUP[B=OPEN].
BACKUP=OPEN / BACKUP=CLOSE were rejected (ASBN-021 Expecting a [) on a V9.40 SpotTool+ servo-gun controller; BACKUP[B=CLOSE,ANTIC=20] was accepted.
Rejected (ASBN-092) on a V9.40 SpotTool+ controller - an example from a manual for another application.
motion-option:GUN=ON (ASCII EXAMPLE).summary: A motion option seen in spot welding .LS files.

motion-option:UPDET_OFS.probe: accepted: L P[1] 2000mm/sec CNT50 : SPOT[...] : UPDET_OFS=3.0mm -> + :SPOT[S=1] UPDET_OFS=3.0mm

notes: On a V9.40 SpotTool+ servo-gun controller (one weld controller) WC= is dropped: ISO CONTACTOR[WC=1,OPEN] is stored as ISO CONTACTOR[OPEN]; [WC=1,CL] is rejected (expects OPEN or CLOSE).
instruction:ISO CONTACTOR.probe: accepted: ISO CONTACTOR[WC=1,OPEN] -> ISO CONTACTOR[OPEN]; rejected: ISO CONTACTOR[WC=1,CL]

notes: TRQ ERROR on the pendant menu is an abbreviation; TRQ ERROR ON is rejected by the loader (ASBN-098).
instruction:TORQUE ERROR ON.probe: accepted: TORQUE ERROR ON/OFF (SpotTool+); rejected: TRQ ERROR ON

notes: GET DIAG DATA on the pendant menu is an abbreviation; it is rejected by the loader (ASBN-092).
instruction:GET DIAGNOSIS DATA.probe: accepted: GET DIAGNOSIS DATA (SpotTool+); rejected: GET DIAG DATA

notes: One word in the program: Soft Float[1] is rejected (ASBN-098).
instruction:SOFTFLOAT.probe: accepted: SOFTFLOAT[1], SOFTFLOAT[10]; rejected: Soft Float[1]

instruction:SOFTFLOAT END.probe: accepted: SOFTFLOAT END; rejected: Soft Float END

program-call:MAKEDIR.summary: Listed with SRWRTCSV/UPLDFIL as a file utility (creates a directory); arguments not documented.

program-call:TWKCALC2.summary: Computes per-tip wear from total wear using the robot-tip wear ratio (one-step method). TWKCALC(ratio) is the older one-argument form.

program-call:DSPWEBPG.summary: Shows a web page on the iPendant (HandlingTool names the macro program DSP_WEBP). Installed on the controller, not in the workspace.
